# `silk/core`

<!-- Generated by packages/compiler/scripts/generate-documentation.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Foundational allocation and standard-output services used by higher standard-library actors.

## When to use

Provide [`Allocator`](#declaration-73696c6b2f636f72653a3a416c6c6f6361746f72) to operations that may create owned storage, normally with
[`SystemAllocator`](#declaration-73696c6b2f636f72653a3a53797374656d416c6c6f6361746f72). Use [`StandardStreams`](#declaration-73696c6b2f636f72653a3a5374616e6461726453747265616d73) for complete byte messages to stdout or stderr;
structured logging belongs in `silk.logging`.

## Details

Both capabilities are ordinary source-declared services. Their requirements remain in an
Effect until a caller supplies a provider, so tests and applications can replace process-backed
implementations lexically. Allocation failure is typed as [`OutOfMemoryError`](#declaration-73696c6b2f636f72653a3a4f75744f664d656d6f7279), and stream failure as
[`StreamWriteError`](#declaration-73696c6b2f636f72653a3a53747265616d57726974654661696c757265).

Import as `Allocator` with `import silk.core`.

Public declarations: 12.
